question: Can a single 8.6% beer get you arrested for driving in Italy?
answer: One 44 cl beer at 8.6% was followed, 15 minutes later, by a reading of 1.09 g/L on a professional breathalyzer. The limit is 0.5 g/L, so driving at that level could mean arrest.
move: One strong beer can be enough to make driving illegal.

web.label: Card asking whether one 44 cl beer at 8.6% can push a driver over Italy's 0.5 g/L blood alcohol limit. A minus and plus counter lets the reader guess the breathalyzer reading 15 minutes later. The reveal shows 1.09 g/L.
